1 """foundry_api.py — the REAL-data API layer behind the folded-in Foundry GUI.
2 
3 This is a faithful Python port of ``foundry-gui/server.mjs`` (the standalone
4 Node sidecar the React app used to talk to). Folding the GUI INTO Anchor means
5 Anchor's ``anchor_gui.py`` now serves the built React app from
6 ``foundry-gui/dist`` AND answers the app's ``/api/*`` calls itself — no second
7 server, no port 8780.
8 
9 Every value traces to a file on disk (the manifest, each skill's SKILL.md +
10 journal, the North Star doc, the sleep-run artifacts); a missing file is an
11 honest empty, never a crash. The three ``sleep_session`` verbs spawn the REAL
12 foundry-v2 kernel CLI (``sleep-kernel-cli.mjs``) headlessly and return its
13 genuine JSON records — nothing here fabricates a proposal.
14 
15 Stdlib only (json/os/re/subprocess/pathlib/shutil) — ``node`` is invoked as an
16 external CLI, exactly as Anchor already shells out to ``git``/``gh``.
17 """

80 def _resolve_source(source):
81     """Resolve a manifest ``source`` to an absolute directory."""
82     if not source:
83         return None
84     if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]", source):
85         return source
86     return os.path.join(FOUNDRY_ROOT, source)
87 
88 
89 def _extract_yaml_description(frontmatter):
90     """Extract the ``description:`` value from YAML frontmatter — handling both
91     an INLINE scalar (``description: text``) AND a BLOCK scalar
92     (``description: >-`` / ``|`` folded or literal, the value on the following
93     indented lines). Returns "" when absent.
94 
95     server.mjs (and this port's first cut) only read the same line as
96     ``description:``, so a block scalar yielded just the ``>-`` indicator — the
97     reason crucible/foreman showed an empty North Star while inline-description
98     skills (researchPrime, gandalf, …) worked.
99     """
100     lines = re.split(r"\r?\n", frontmatter)
101     for i, line in enumerate(lines):
102         m = re.match(r"^description:[ \t]*(.*)$", line)
103         if not m:
104             continue
105         inline = m.group(1).strip()
106         block = re.match(r"^([>|])[-+]?\s*$", inline)  # >, >-, >+, |, |-, |+
107         if not block:
108             return inline  # a plain inline scalar (or empty)
109         style = block.group(1)  # '>' folded | '|' literal
110         collected = []
111         for cont in lines[i + 1:]:
112             if cont.strip() == "":
113                 collected.append("")  # blank line inside the block
114                 continue
115             if len(cont) - len(cont.lstrip()) == 0:
116                 break  # dedent to a new top-level key — block ended
117             collected.append(cont.strip())
118         while collected and collected[-1] == "":
119             collected.pop()
120         if style == "|":  # literal: keep line breaks
121             return "\n".join(collected)
122         # folded: blank line = paragraph break, otherwise space-join
123         paras, para = [], []
124         for c in collected:
125             if c == "":
126                 if para:
127                     paras.append(" ".join(para))
128                     para = []
129             else:
130                 para.append(c)
131         if para:
132             paras.append(" ".join(para))
133         return "\n\n".join(paras)
134     return ""

137 def _parse_skill_md(text):
138     """Parse SKILL.md into ``{description, body}``. Frontmatter is optional."""
139     if not text:
140         return {"description": "", "body": ""}
141     body = text
142     description = ""
143     fm = re.match(r"^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---\r?\n?", text)
144     if fm:
145         body = text[len(fm.group(0)):]
146         description = _extract_yaml_description(fm.group(1))
147     return {"description": description, "body": body}
148 
149 
150 def _parse_human_md(text):
151     """Parse HUMAN.md (people-first skill card) into one-sentence + body.
152 
153     Prefer ``**One sentence:** …`` then first non-heading line. Used for
154     human-facing Foundry UI surfaces; agent SKILL.md stays the protocol source.
155     """
156     if not text:
157         return {"oneSentence": "", "body": ""}
158     body = str(text).strip()
159     one = ""
160     m = re.search(r"\*\*One sentence:\*\*\s*(.+?)(?:\r?\n|$)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
161     if not m:
162         m = re.search(r"^One sentence:\s*(.+?)(?:\r?\n|$)", body, re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
163     if m:
164         one = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(1).strip())
165     if not one:
166         for line in re.split(r"\r?\n", body):
167             t = line.strip()
168             if not t or t.startswith("#"):
169                 continue
170             one = re.sub(r"^\*\*|\*\*$", "", t).strip()
171             break
172     return {"oneSentence": one, "body": body}
173 
174 
175 def _extract_sections(body):
176     """Top-level ``## `` section titles from the SKILL.md body."""
177     if not body:
178         return []
179     out = []
180     for line in re.split(r"\r?\n", body):
181         m = re.match(r"^##\s+(.+)$", line)
182         if m:
183             out.append(m.group(1).strip())
184     return out
185 
186 
187 def _extract_section_details(body):
188     """Return ``[{title, detail}]`` for each top-level ``## `` section — the
189     heading plus its markdown body (until the next ``## `` or a new ``# ``
190     heading, or the end). Powers the click-to-expand Capabilities tile: each
191     bullet (the title) reveals its section's real content. Long sections are
192     truncated to keep the /api/skills payload sane."""
193     if not body:
194         return []
195     sections = []
196     cur = None
197     for line in re.split(r"\r?\n", body):
198         if re.match(r"^##\s+(.+)$", line):
199             if cur is not None:
200                 sections.append(cur)
201             cur = {"title": re.match(r"^##\s+(.+)$", line).group(1).strip(),
202                    "lines": []}
203         elif re.match(r"^#\s+(.+)$", line) and cur is not None:
204             sections.append(cur)  # a new '# ' heading closes the ## section
205             cur = None
206         elif cur is not None:
207             cur["lines"].append(line)
208     if cur is not None:
209         sections.append(cur)
210     out = []
211     for s in sections:
212         detail = "\n".join(s["lines"]).strip()
213         if len(detail) > 12000:
214             detail = detail[:12000].rstrip() + "\n\n…(truncated)"
215         out.append({"title": s["title"], "detail": detail})
216     return out
217 
218 
219 def _first_paragraph(body):
220     """First non-empty paragraph (per-skill north-star fallback)."""
221     if not body:
222         return ""
223     for block in re.split(r"\r?\n\s*\r?\n", body):
224         if block.strip():
225             return block.strip()
226     return ""

229 def _journal_events(skill_dir):
230     """Real journal entries for a skill dir: files directly in
231     ``<dir>/journal/*.md``, ignoring README.md, subdirectories and all-caps
232     files. Each = ``{event, timestamp (mtime ms), status:'success', details}``.
233     """
234     journal_dir = os.path.join(skill_dir, "journal")
235     events = []
236     for dirent in _read_dir_safe(journal_dir):
237         if not dirent.is_file():
238             continue
239         file_name = dirent.name
240         low = file_name.lower()
241         if not low.endswith(".md"):
242             continue
243         if low == "readme.md":
244             continue
245         base = re.sub(r"\.md$", "", file_name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
246         # all-caps entries (SYNTHESIS.md etc.) are not run records
247         if re.search(r"[A-Z]", base) and not re.search(r"[a-z]", base):
248             continue
249         file_path = os.path.join(journal_dir, file_name)
250         st = _stat_safe(file_path)
251         if not st:
252             continue
253         text = _read_text_safe(file_path) or ""
254         heading = re.search(r"^#\s+(.+)$", text, re.MULTILINE)
255         if heading:
256             title = heading.group(1).strip()
257         else:
258             first_line = next((l for l in re.split(r"\r?\n", text) if l.strip()), None)
259             title = first_line.strip() if first_line else base
260         details = text
261         if heading:
262             details = details.replace(heading.group(0), "")
263         details = details.strip()[:280]
264         events.append({
265             "event": title,
266             "timestamp": st.st_mtime * 1000.0,
267             "status": "success",
268             "details": details,
269         })
270     events.sort(key=lambda e: e["timestamp"], reverse=True)
271     return events

274 def _load_manifest():
275     """Load the manifest fresh; ``[]`` when missing/unparseable."""
276     text = _read_text_safe(MANIFEST_PATH)
277     if not text:
278         return []
279     try:
280         parsed = json.loads(text)
281     except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
282         return []
283     skills = parsed.get("skills")
284     return skills if isinstance(skills, list) else []

287 def build_skills():
288     """The full real ``/api/skills`` payload from the manifest + each skill's
289     files. Human-facing ``description`` / ``northStar`` prefer HUMAN.md when
290     present; SKILL.md remains agent protocol (agentDescription + sections)."""
291     out = []
292     for entry in _load_manifest():
293         skill_dir = _resolve_source(entry.get("source"))
294         skill_md = _read_text_safe(os.path.join(skill_dir, "SKILL.md")) if skill_dir else None
295         human_md = _read_text_safe(os.path.join(skill_dir, "HUMAN.md")) if skill_dir else None
296         parsed = _parse_skill_md(skill_md)
297         agent_description, body = parsed["description"], parsed["body"]
298         human = _parse_human_md(human_md)
299         description = human["oneSentence"] or agent_description or _first_paragraph(body)
300         north_star = (human["body"][:4000] if human["body"]
301                       else (agent_description or _first_paragraph(body)))
302         human_sections = _extract_sections(human["body"]) if human["body"] else []
303         agent_sections = _extract_sections(body)
304         human_details = _extract_section_details(human["body"]) if human["body"] else []
305         agent_details = _extract_section_details(body)
306         timeline = _journal_events(skill_dir) if skill_dir else []
307         edges = entry.get("edges") if isinstance(entry.get("edges"), list) else []
308         src = entry.get("source") or ""
309         out.append({
310             "ref": entry.get("ref", ""),
311             "name": entry.get("name", ""),
312             "source": src,
313             "status": entry.get("status", ""),
314             "tier": entry.get("tier", ""),
315             "version": entry.get("version", ""),
316             "description": description,
317             "agentDescription": agent_description or "",
318             "humanCard": bool(human_md),
319             "humanOneSentence": human["oneSentence"] or "",
320             "northStar": north_star,
321             "file_path": (src + "/SKILL.md") if src else "",
322             "human_path": (src + "/HUMAN.md") if (src and human_md) else "",
323             "capabilities": human_sections if human_sections else agent_sections,
324             "capabilitySections": human_details if human_details else agent_details,
325             "dependencies": [d for d in (
326                 re.sub(r"^skill:", "", str(e.get("to", ""))) for e in edges) if d],
327             "edges": edges,
328             "timeline": timeline,
329             "journalCount": len(timeline),
330         })
331     return out
332

339 def _sleep_run_stats():
340     """REAL sleep-run stats from the artifacts on disk (a run = a proposal.json dir)."""
341     runs = 0
342     last_improved = None
343     for dirent in _read_dir_safe(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR):
344         if not dirent.is_dir():
345             continue
346         run_dir = os.path.join(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR, dirent.name)
347         if not _stat_safe(os.path.join(run_dir, "proposal.json")):
348             continue
349         runs += 1
350         apply_path = os.path.join(run_dir, "apply-result.json")
351         apply_stat = _stat_safe(apply_path)
352         if apply_stat:
353             try:
354                 rec = json.loads(_read_text_safe(apply_path) or "null")
355                 if rec and rec.get("outcome") == "applied":
356                     last_improved = max(last_improved or 0, apply_stat.st_mtime * 1000.0)
357             except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
358                 pass
359     return {"runs": runs, "lastImproved": last_improved}

402 # ── the REAL sleep-session kernel (spawned, never simulated) ─────────────────
403 
404 def _run_kernel(args):
405     """Spawn ``node <KERNEL_CLI> <verb> <args…>`` headlessly. Never raises —
406     returns ``{status, spawnError, timedOut, stdout, stderr}`` so the caller can
407     surface the kernel's honest exit codes (0 ok / 3 refused / 1 blocked)."""
408     try:
409         proc = subprocess.run(
410             [_node_cmd(), KERNEL_CLI, *args],
411             cwd=KERNEL_DIR,
412             capture_output=True,
413             text=True,
414             encoding="utf-8",
415             timeout=KERNEL_TIMEOUT_S,
416         )
417         return {"status": proc.returncode, "spawnError": None,
418                 "timedOut": False, "stdout": proc.stdout or "",
419                 "stderr": proc.stderr or ""}
420     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
421         return {"status": None, "spawnError": None, "timedOut": True,
422                 "stdout": exc.stdout or "", "stderr": exc.stderr or ""}
423     except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
424         return {"status": None, "spawnError": str(exc), "timedOut": False,
425                 "stdout": "", "stderr": ""}
426 
427 
428 def _parse_kernel_json(stdout):
429     text = (stdout or "").strip()
430     if not text:
431         return None
432     try:
433         return json.loads(text)
434     except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
435         return None
436

438 def _resolve_proposal_dir(body):
439     """Resolve the proposal dir from ``{proposalPath | proposalId}``; the result
440     MUST live inside SLEEP_RUNS_DIR (every proposal this server mints does) — a
441     path outside it is refused (None)."""
442     candidate = None
443     if isinstance(body.get("proposalPath"), str) and body["proposalPath"].strip():
444         candidate = os.path.abspath(body["proposalPath"].strip())
445     elif isinstance(body.get("proposalId"), str) and body["proposalId"].strip():
446         candidate = os.path.join(str(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR),
447                                  os.path.basename(body["proposalId"].strip()))
448     if not candidate:
449         return None
450     runs_root = os.path.abspath(str(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR))
451     normalized = os.path.abspath(candidate)
452     if normalized != runs_root and not normalized.startswith(runs_root + os.sep):
453         return None
454     return normalized
455 
456 
457 _SKILL_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$")
458 
459 
460 def sleep_propose(body):
461     """POST /api/foundry/sleep_session/propose — spawn the kernel `propose`.
462     Returns ``(payload, status_code)``."""
463     skill = str(body.get("skill") or "gandalf").strip()
464     if not _SKILL_NAME_RE.match(skill):
465         return {"error": f"invalid skill name: {json.dumps(skill)}"}, 400
466     skill_dir = os.path.join(SKILLS_ROOT, skill)
467     if not (_stat_safe(skill_dir) and os.path.isdir(skill_dir)):
468         return {"error": f"skill directory not found: {skill_dir}"}, 404
469     os.makedirs(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
470     run = _run_kernel(["propose", skill_dir, "--repo", SKILLS_REPO,
471                        "--runs-dir", str(SLEEP_RUNS_DIR)])
472     parsed = _parse_kernel_json(run["stdout"])
473     if not parsed or parsed.get("error") or run["status"] != 0 or run["spawnError"]:
474         return {
475             "error": (parsed and parsed.get("error")) or run["spawnError"]
476             or f"kernel propose exited {run['status']}"
477             + (" (timed out)" if run["timedOut"] else ""),
478             "stderr": run["stderr"],
479         }, 500
480     # Enrich each unit with its REAL diff text (the artifact the kernel wrote).
481     for unit in ((parsed.get("proposal") or {}).get("units") or []):
482         diff_text = _read_text_safe(unit.get("diffPath"))
483         if diff_text is not None:
484             unit["diffText"] = diff_text
485     return parsed, 200
486

488 def sleep_apply(body):
489     """POST /api/foundry/sleep_session/apply — confirm-gated kernel `apply`."""
490     if body.get("confirm") is not True:
491         return {"error": "refused: confirm must be exactly true — the human is "
492                 "the promotion authority", "outcome": "refused"}, 409
493     proposal_dir = _resolve_proposal_dir(body)
494     if not proposal_dir:
495         return {"error": "proposalId or proposalPath (inside the sleep-runs dir) required"}, 400
496     if not _stat_safe(os.path.join(proposal_dir, "proposal.json")):
497         return {"error": f"no proposal.json in {proposal_dir}"}, 404
498     args = ["apply", proposal_dir, "--confirm", "foundry-gui-user"]
499     if body.get("unit"):
500         args += ["--unit", str(body["unit"])]
501     run = _run_kernel(args)
502     parsed = _parse_kernel_json(run["stdout"])
503     if not parsed or parsed.get("error") or run["spawnError"]:
504         return {
505             "error": (parsed and parsed.get("error")) or run["spawnError"]
506             or f"kernel apply exited {run['status']}"
507             + (" (timed out)" if run["timedOut"] else ""),
508             "stderr": run["stderr"],
509         }, 500
510     return parsed, (409 if parsed.get("outcome") == "refused" else 200)
511 
512 
513 def sleep_rollback(body):
514     """POST /api/foundry/sleep_session/rollback — kernel `rollback`."""
515     proposal_dir = _resolve_proposal_dir(body)
516     if not proposal_dir:
517         hint = (" (a bare baselineSha is not enough — the kernel reads the "
518                 "frozen baseline from the proposal artifact)"
519                 if body.get("baselineSha") else "")
520         return {"error": "proposalId or proposalPath (inside the sleep-runs "
521                 f"dir) required{hint}"}, 400
522     if not _stat_safe(os.path.join(proposal_dir, "proposal.json")):
523         return {"error": f"no proposal.json in {proposal_dir}"}, 404
524     run = _run_kernel(["rollback", proposal_dir])
525     parsed = _parse_kernel_json(run["stdout"])
526     if not parsed or parsed.get("error") or run["spawnError"]:
527         return {
528             "error": (parsed and parsed.get("error")) or run["spawnError"]
529             or f"kernel rollback exited {run['status']}"
530             + (" (timed out)" if run["timedOut"] else ""),
531             "stderr": run["stderr"],
532         }, 500
533     return parsed, 200

555 def resolve_dist_file(rel_path):
556     """Traversal-safe resolve of a dist-relative path → (abs_path, content_type)
557     or (None, None). ``rel_path`` is the URL path (e.g. "/assets/x.js" or
558     "index.html"); it must stay inside DIST_DIR."""
559     rel = (rel_path or "").split("?", 1)[0].lstrip("/")
560     if not rel:
561         rel = "index.html"
562     try:
563         resolved = (DIST_DIR / rel).resolve()
564     except (OSError, ValueError):
565         return None, None
566     if resolved != DIST_DIR and DIST_DIR not in resolved.parents:
567         return None, None
568     if not resolved.is_file():
569         return None, None
570     ctype = _CONTENT_TYPES.get(resolved.suffix.lower(), "application/octet-stream")
571     return resolved, ctype
